title: The Daily Gazette: Pioneer Bancorp ranks 79th on Fortune's fastest-growing companies list
summary: Pioneer Bancorp (NASDAQ: PBFS), with 22 offices in the Capital Region, was ranked No. 79 in the Fortune 2025 100 Fastest-Growing Companies ranking list released on Tuesday.
body_markdown:
'Being recognized by Fortune reflects the success of a diversified strategy built right here in the Capital Region,' Thomas Amell, President and CEO of Pioneer, said in a media release. 'By expanding our business lines and income streams, we’ve positioned Pioneer for long-term, sustainable growth as we continue to invest in the clients, employees, and communities we serve both locally and beyond.'"


[Read the full story covered by Stan Hudy in the Daily Gazette here.](https://www.dailygazette.com/news/business/pioneer-bancorp-ranks-79th-on-fortunes-fastest-growing-companies-list/article_b662fe0f-9ef0-49dc-8306-61aeec285003.html)
